messages:
nora (product): Heads-up: quick UX review for API Keys page. Need decisions on empty-state layout, keyboard-first CTA placement, and the secret reveal microcopy before code freeze.

samir (design): Recs: make primary CTA keyboard-first (visible focus should land on 'Create your first key'), and put action before explanation in the empty state. Also propose an optional ephemeral demo key for brand-new orgs.

paul (devex): Agreed on focus-first. For secret reveal, prefer inline card with a short banner: 'Save this secret now  it won't be shown again.' Primary action: 'Copy', secondary: 'Download .env'. For download, we generate a JS blob.

anya (eng): Technical note: we'll mask the secret in DOM after 25s and clear JS memory. Backend will not log secrets. Drawer adds complexity; inline works and meets the MVP timeline.

clara (a11y): Accessibility: when a key is created, use aria-live polite to announce 'API key created. Secret available for copying.' Move focus to the secret container. Copy button aria-label should include 'will not be shown again'. Empty state CTA must be reachable by keyboard and have visible focus.

samir (design): Empty-state copy options: Option A (action-first): 'Create your first key' with 3 tiny use-case chips. Option B (demo): 'Try an ephemeral demo key' (new orgs only). Which do we ship?

nora (product): Ship Option A for existing orgs; enable Option B just for the signup flow. Add 'Invite Key Manager' link to the empty state to avoid blocking.

paul (devex): For revoke: immediate revoke + 30s undo snackbar. Revoke confirmation should warn: 'Revoking may immediately break apps that use this key.' Use stronger language.

anya (eng): We'll add last_used column to support cleanup. Role gating for 'View secret' is enforced server-side. I'll raise the API ticket.

clara (a11y): Also ensure table headers announce sort state and keyboard focus rings are visible. Warning banners need 4.5:1 contrast if text-only.

nora (product): Action items: samir -> update mocks with keyboard-first focus and demo variant; clara -> small ARIA snippet doc; paul -> download-blob + mask TTL doc; anya -> API ticket for last_used & role gating. I'll add to the sprint.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch "feature/keys-emptystate-focus" to staging at 2026-03-23T15:40:00Z

nora (product): Thanks team!"
